items.title: What happens as gut feel takes over from the rubric?
items.description: This is a simplified teaching model, not a real hiring formula. Candidate A scores 3 on the rubric but leaves a stronger first impression (5); Candidate B scores 5 on the rubric but leaves a weaker first impression (3) — on the rubric alone, B is ahead by 2 points. Drag the slider from rubric-driven to impression-driven and watch B's advantage shrink, vanish, and reverse as gut feel takes over.
items.compute: const rubricA = 3; const rubricB = 5; const impressionA = 5; const impressionB = 3; const w = params.gutWeight / 100; const candidateAScore = rubricA * (1 - w) + impressionA * w; const candidateBScore = rubricB * (1 - w) + impressionB * w; const scoreGap = Math.round((candidateBScore - candidateAScore) * 10) / 10; return { scoreGap };
